Rajasthan_State_Reservation.total_reservation: 49% total seats reserved in educational institutions

SC.details: Reserved seats for SC category students in all government educational institutions

ST.details: Reserved seats for ST category students including special provisions for Saharia tribe

OBC.details: Reserved seats for OBC category students (Non-Creamy Layer only)

MBC.details: Special sub-category within OBC with additional benefits in some cases

EWS.details: For General category students with family income below ₹8 lakh per annum
EWS.income_limit: Annual family income must be less than ₹8,00,000
EWS.property_criteria: Should not own 5 acres or more agricultural land, residential plot of 1000 sq ft or more in notified municipalities, or residential plot of 100 sq yards or more in other areas

creamy_layer.info: OBC students from 'Creamy Layer' (high-income families) are not eligible for reservation

additional_reservations.women: Horizontal reservation for women in certain courses/institutions

additional_reservations.ex_servicemen: Special reservation for children of ex-servicemen/defense personnel

Central_Universities_Reservation.applicable_to: Central University of Rajasthan and other central institutions

management_quota.info: Private medical colleges have management quota seats

University_Reservation.UG_PG_admissions: University of Rajasthan and other state universities follow Rajasthan state reservation policy

ST_Certificate.special_note: Saharia tribe has additional benefits in Rajasthan

fee_concession.OBC: Partial fee concession in many institutions
